companies.name: Ultraviolette Automotive
companies.reason: Ultraviolette Automotive has gained significant attention with its launch of the F77 electric motorcycle at EICMA 2023, indicating a strong market entry with international potential. The company is focused on developing India's first high-performance electric vehicle ecosystem, which positions it well in the rapidly growing EV market.

companies.name: Ather Energy
companies.reason: Ather Energy has reported an 88% year-on-year sales growth in 2023, indicating strong demand for its electric scooters. The company also celebrated the rollout of its 200,000th electric vehicle, reinforcing its footprint in the Indian e-scooter market and solidifying its position as a leader in the electric two-wheeler segment.
